items.snippet: Temple, the INR 85,000 wearable device by eternal entrepreneur Deepinder Goyal, is facing backlash after clinical specialists raised questions about its scientific claims and demanded a government probe. Researchers said there was not enough evidence to support certain advertized metrics.

items.title: Tesla to Phase Out Cybertruck Production to Accelerate Cybercab Rollout
items.snippet: Tesla plans to cease Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory by mid-2027 to focus on making its self-driving Cybercab vehicle. The move was revealed by CEO Elon Musk, purportedly to reverse years of dismal Cybertruck sales.

items.title: Qantas Airways Plans 850 Layoffs in Australia, Shifts Some Operations to India
items.snippet: Qantas Airways is set to lose about 850 positions in Australia as part of a comprehensive overhaul and cost-cutting plan. The airline will outsource a variety of corporate services like marketing, finance, personnel resources and procurement to Accenture.

items.title: Nvidia’s Board Investigation into Huang’s Alleged Affair Faces Potential Conflict of Interest
items.snippet: Nvidia has begun an independent board investigation into allegations that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman accused of espionage. There is no indication that trade secrets have been leaked or security compromised.
